plan_a_advantages: Includes a tempo run to improve speed and lactate threshold.
Incorporates strength and mobility work for injury prevention and performance.
Offers a more varied training stimulus, promoting well-rounded development.
plan_b_advantages: Focuses exclusively on easy running, which can be beneficial for building a solid aerobic base without excessive fatigue.
Provides specific trail running data (distance, elevation, heart rate) for each easy run, offering more detailed feedback.
reasoning: While both plans incorporate rest days and focus on running, Plan A is better suited for an athlete aiming to become a faster trail runner. Plan A includes a tempo run, which is crucial for improving lactate threshold and speed at a sustained effort. Plan B consists entirely of easy runs, which, while important for building a base, won't significantly contribute to speed development. The inclusion of strength and mobility work in Plan A also addresses a key component of trail running performance and injury prevention.
